summary: A monthly coffee mixer held inside Keller Williams Professionals' own office at 48 Grove Street, Asheville, explicitly for "agents to get to know other agents." It is an internal networking/team-building event run by a single real estate brokerage for its own agents, not a chapter or club with membership drawn from multiple businesses or the public.

evidence.note: 8 monthly listings, all at Keller Williams Professionals' own office (48 Grove St), tagged 'Agents Only' and 'Real Estate Agents'; description each time is just 'Time for agents to get to know other agents!'

Full listing confirms it's a 1-hour in-office networking gathering for real estate agents with coffee/breakfast from City Bakery, organized directly by the Keller Williams brokerage, with no membership form, dues, or external community link.

Web search for 'Morning Mingle Keller Williams Professionals Asheville' and 'Morning Mingle Asheville Grove Street real estate' turned up only the KW brokerage's general web presence (Facebook page, Yelp, LinkedIn) and unrelated results; no dedicated page, Facebook group, or Meetup for this event exists.

Unlike networking chapters with cross-business membership (e.g. BNI/IBN-style groups), this gathers agents who already work together at the same brokerage in their own building, closer to an internal staff social than a discoverable community group.
